content: विपक्ष {%a.%} .²1 Hostile, inimical, adverse, contrary. .²2 Impartial. .{@-क्षः@} .²1 An enemy, adversary, opponent; गुणास्तस्य विपक्षेऽपि गुणिनो लेभिरेऽन्तरम् <ls>R. 17. 75</ls>; <ls>Śi. 11. 59</ls>. .²2 A rival or fellow wife; प्रेमगर्वितविपक्षमत्सरात् <ls>R. 19. 20</ls>. .²3 A disputant; हृतोत्तरं तत्त्वविचारमध्ये वक्तेव दोषैर्गुरुभिर्विपक्षम् <ls>Ki. 17. 43</ls>. .²4 (In logic) A negative instance, an instance on the opposite side, ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} that in which the साध्य or major term is not found); निश्चितसाध्याभाववान् विपक्षः <ls>T. S.</ls>; <ls>Mu. 5. 10</ls>. .²5 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) An exception. .²6 Impartiality, indifference. .²7 The day of transition from one-half of a lunar month to another.
